caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame without a mattress. The bed frame is painted in a bluish-gray color, giving the wood a weathered appearance. It consists of four posts, each with a rounded finial at the top. The headboard and footboard have similar shapes, featuring curved upper edges and cut-out decorative sections. The side rails connect the posts and have evenly spaced pegs or knobs along their upper surface, possibly intended for holding slats or ropes. The legs of the bed are turned and slightly taper as they extend downward. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Bedstead
